articles.title: Cotton Candy Planets: Astronomers Find Two Super-Puffs in One System
articles.summary: Astronomers discovered two Jupiter-sized planets less dense than cotton candy, orbiting a Sun-like star 1,113 light-years away. Only a handful of these rare 'super-puffs' are known.

articles.title: Fire Arrows and Funeral Boats: Did Vikings Really Do That?
articles.summary: Movies show Vikings shooting fire arrows at funeral boats, but experts say there's no archaeological evidence. The fiery ritual may be a Hollywood invention from the 1958 film 'The Vikings.'

articles.title: Asian Games Day 1: Xu Jiayu Sets Record at 31, Teen Stars Shine
articles.summary: At the 2026 Asian Games, 31-year-old Xu Jiayu won the 100m backstroke in a record 51.98 seconds. Teen swimmer Yu Zidi and veteran Satomi Suzuki also set records on day one.
